title: dedicated: autoscaler burst SLO adjustment + burst utilization reporting fix
author: Asha Patel
description: Fix two issues observed in production fleets: (1) autoscaler was treating short high-traffic spikes as steady load causing unnecessary scale-ups and missed throughput SLOs when bursts were exhausted, and (2) burst utilization metrics were underreported by ~30% due to a race between tokenbucket updates and reporting windows. This PR introduces tokenbucket smoothing tuned for short spikes, adjusts autoscaler SLO thresholds to prefer brief burst shedding over scale-ups, and fixes the burst_utilization reporting race by moving metric emission to the synchronized drain path. Also includes integration tests, docs, and a telemetry migration note. No behavioral changes to default quotas except a small SLO threshold tweak (config flag provided to opt-out).
commits: smoothing: add tokenbucket smoothing implementation and config toggles
autscale: adjust SLO thresholds and prefer burst-shed+queue fallback over immediate scale-up
metrics: emit burst_utilization from synchronized drain path to fix underreporting race
tests: add integration test for short spike behavior and burst reporting
docs: update dedicated autoscaler docs and release notes
fix: address flake in autoscaler unit test by stabilizing clock mocks
